drawings.kind: two planes in perspective (one crossed by a line)
drawings.notes: Two parallelograms (planes in perspective), one above the other: the first crossed by a thick line carrying a point, the second marked with a single point; its lower edge is doubled, drawn as a second stroke. The strokes at the top left and right of the crop belong to the sketch above and to the text. The other sketches of the left margin (the cone, the line Z' bar through a point, Z' bar minus a point) are described in the transcription's notes, not in this mark, and are not drawn.
